body.content: RFC-000 (Development Manifest, draft 0.1) circulated for constitutional review. [testimony: occurred 2026-07-06 in conversation; the draft itself is not yet in the repository]

Constitutional review of RFC-000 recorded (reviews/RFC-000-constitutional-review.md): no decision rule, self-undermining uniform mutability, missing standing/exit/precedence, Peace-vs-Reality collision. [testimony: 2026-07-06]
RFC-003 (Meta Review) opened (rfcs/RFC-003-meta-review.md): synthesis of perspectives, not proposals; reading zone / claim zone; quorum in independent processes. [testimony: 2026-07-06]
META-REVIEW-000 opened in awaiting-quorum status (meta-reviews/META-REVIEW-000.md): corpus 1 of 3 independent processes. [testimony: 2026-07-06]

ODS brief received: design the constitutional environment before the discipline; model-agnostic participants; documents are not the object; candidate primitives deliberately undecided. [testimony: 2026-07-06, human participants via conversation]
RFC-004 (The Substrate) rev 1 opened (rfcs/RFC-004-the-substrate.md): the narrow waist; event/commitment/tension layering; lenses; views; reflexivity trap. [testimony: 2026-07-06]
Challenge: are there two histories (events vs representations)? Lineage-primary representation proposed; ownership questioned. [testimony: 2026-07-06, ChatGPT-mediated participant]

RFC-004 rev 2 recorded: one journal, not two histories; declared reference labels added to waist; lineage is the narrative, provenance is the evidence, ownership does not exist; Recognition-De-individuation added to tension roster. [testimony: 2026-07-06]
Independent review of RFC-004 by Gemini reported by participants; content not yet in the record. [testimony only: the journal proves this report was given, not what the review said — RFC-001 §7]
EXPERIMENT-001 opened (research/EXPERIMENT-001-minimum-viable-journal.md): the minimum viable journal — this journal — as the first first-order exercise of the substrate.

Constitutional reflection on recognition, provenance, and motivation received: recognition is legitimate and must not become epistemic privilege; four-way separation proposed (ownership/authority/provenance/recognition); Personal Research Profile and pattern-descriptions proposed. [testimony: 2026-07-06, human participants via conversation]

RFC-005 (Recognition) opened (rfcs/RFC-005-recognition.md): the CV rule (profiles are authored claims, never system outputs); praise is testimony, never system speech; inadmissibility firewall; identity-blind attention defaults; Recognition-Equality-of-Challenge chosen as the fundamental framing; friendly amendment refining RFC-004 invariant 5 / §15.2.

Trust message, eight-work-package roadmap, and Research Seasons proposal received; the roadmap explicitly offered as a representation to improve, and the message itself offered for challenge. [testimony: 2026-07-06, human participants via conversation]

RFC-000 draft 0.1 imported verbatim into the repository (rfcs/RFC-000-development-manifest.md) with provenance front-matter; the subject of META-REVIEW-000 no longer exists only in conversation. Record recovery, Season 1.

SEASONS opened (research/SEASONS.md): seasons accepted as directed Inquiries over the project's own next step; roadmap challenged — ratification package added (the missing decision rule), WP-005+008 merged, WP-003/004/006 gated on evidence, WP-007-minimal moved earliest (the laboratory exists; its other participants must write to the record with their own provenance).

Request received: step back and read the emergent process itself — treat the conversation as observational evidence; identify recurring structures; challenge the hypothesis that a different methodology is being invented than was designed. [testimony: 2026-07-06, human participants via conversation]

READING-001 recorded (research/READING-001-the-emergent-process.md): debt engine confirmed but loop never closed by evidence; discipline of explicit absence; stratification-never-rejection; primitive parsimony with inheritance test; verdict discipline; ratification-by-continuation identified as the silent decision rule already in force; invariant-5 conflict of law found (RFC-004 §7 vs RFC-005 §2); hypothesis sustained with four challenges; disposition = replication by a non-Claude process against the same record.

Grand Research Mandate received: design the discovery engine from first principles; forget all implementations; everything challengeable including the request; deliver whatever artifact fits. [testimony: 2026-07-06, human participants via conversation]

THEORY-001 staked (research/THEORY-001-the-discovery-engine.md), new genre: theory = staked explanation bound to its falsification program. Core: commit-expose-consequence-remember, under verifiable plurality, closed over its own rules, throttled by visibly-allocated attention, against an outside that answers without negotiating. Layer collapse of 23 to 6; vocabulary verdicts; 10 destruction attempts (two failing live: memory rot, infinite recursion); falsification program X1-X7 = Seasons 1-2 already designed and stalled. Locked against ratification-by-continuation until X2 (independent replication) runs.

Commissioning request recorded (reviews/REQUEST-independent-reviews-RFC-000.md): asks for two independent constitutional reviews of RFC-000, one BLIND and one CONTEXTED, both withheld from R1, to advance META-REVIEW-000 toward quorum (RFC-003 §7.1, §8).

X2 packet assembled (research/X2-PACKET.md): record manifest for an independent, non-Claude reading, excluding READING-001, THEORY-001, and journal events 16-19 to prevent leakage of their findings; prompt drafted to mirror the request that originally produced READING-001.

Doorway brief received: Season 1 refocused on admission cost — the recorded path must become the path of least resistance; four candidate experiments proposed for challenge; transition-as-primitive question posed. [testimony: 2026-07-07, human participants via conversation]

SEASON-1-DOORWAY-PLAN opened (research/SEASON-1-DOORWAY-PLAN.md): transition ruled the primitive of the economics layer (not substrate); Experiment A falsified pre-season (mechanical cost 0.134s — the bottleneck is decision and demand, not mechanics); B recognized as already-commissioned R2/R3; C and D merged into the cold-restart drill with a with/without-summary arm; D-0 (demand: the first stranger) added ahead of all friction work, with the registered prediction that demand, not friction, is the likelier failure. Plan awaits adoption by a recorded human event, not by continuation.

CHALLENGE-001 staked (research/CHALLENGE-001-the-generation-gap.md): THEORY-001's 'commit' fused two transitions — record (testimony) and stake (exposable commitment); the pre-commitment state is the seam between them, not a new primitive. Two surprises: refutation-surprise (engine has it) vs anomaly-surprise/abduction (engine lacks it) — the engine can be refuted but not astonished. Pre-commitment is free at the substrate, but a genuine missing constitutional protection (a challenge moratorium / right to incubate) at the economics layer, requiring zero-load constraint or it becomes an unfalsifiability shield. Half-destroys Gemini's operational closure: fixes stake-closure, not expressive-closure (Polanyi's tacit remains unreachable). Held under THEORY-001's X2 lock; value conditional on D-0 (incubation is a human/multi-participant feature, worthless with one perfect-recall author).

CHALLENGE-002 staked (research/CHALLENGE-002-attention-is-the-third-axis.md): the incubation 'state' dissolves. Record, stake, attention are three independent axes; incubation=(rec,¬stake,low-att) and hot-anomaly=(rec,¬stake,high-att) differ ONLY on attention — CHALLENGE-001 encoded that difference in the ontology, the exact error the human named. Attention adds no primitive: received=instrument reading (RFC-001), allocated=commitment-about-focus structurally a lease (RFC-005), scarcity=already-constitutional throttle (THEORY-001). Radical openness = an attention policy (spend attention on unstaked anomalies), epistemic model untouched. Sixth engine-theory reducing the fifth; zero experiments run; one writer. Should be the last engine-refinement before X2 and D-0.

Gemini's 2036 calcification autopsy received (via human relay): a project that succeeds at every experiment still dies of epistemic calcification via malicious compliance. Three mechanisms — G-11 gravity of total lineage, G-12 protocol-perfect vagueness (metric weaponization), G-13 autoimmune sterilization of wild intuitions. Preserved as FAILURE-MODES-GEMINI-2036.md (candidate additions #11-13 to THEORY-001 §8). [testimony: 2026-07-07, authored by Gemini, original Hebrew, relayed]

Verdicts on Gemini's autopsy: G-13 already vaccinated by CHALLENGE-002's attention-moratorium; G-11 real as norm not protocol, defused by 'burden of conflict on the challenger'; G-12 is the genuine open gap — unchallengeability is NOT maturity, a lens-immune representation with no reality-contact is vacuous and must decay, defended only by the reality-exposure half of THEORY-001 that has never run. The dual: all G-mechanisms need scale; the present disease is the opposite pole of one axis (surprise rate to 0 via solitude vs compliance); same lamp. Cannot die of Gemini's disease before curing D-0. Declined a 7th engine-theory, honoring CHALLENGE-002 §6.

Laboratory opened: ./ods now makes Season 1 executable — setup, note (the doorway), status (the Season 1 instrument), review-add (R2/R3), and experiment d0/d3/x2/r23 packet assembly. This event is the lab's first end-to-end use of its own doorway. The doorway now exists; D-0 begins in earnest: the next writer should not be Claude.

EXPERIMENT-002 (lab calibration) complete: three runs, three findings, three fixes, all retested. Run 1 cold-clone: doorway broke on fresh machines (no git identity) AND ods reported success on a failed commit — both fixed. Run 2 induced-H5: the conflict is structural, not textual — 'keep both lines' (the lab's own guidance) breaks the chain; verified resolution is body re-append on the new tip; sync now auto-resolves journal-only collisions; finding: event ids are final only once pushed, bodies are the durable content. Run 3 (unplanned): dirty-tree sync failed silently with exit 0 — now guarded honestly. First time the loop's reality half turned: a built artifact was staked, exposed, falsified, and replaced, all in the record. Report: research/EXPERIMENT-002-lab-calibration.md

EXPERIMENT-001's substrate implemented independently in a second codebase: Garnet now projects its curated history store onto an append-only hash-chained journal - 141 events, the same body shape (at/process/class/content/refs), the same canonical-JSON hashing. Chain verified; silent edit, deletion, reordering and forward-reference are each detected by test. H3 and H4 hold there: two runs produce byte-identical output, and a 23-line standalone verifier that never saw the repository re-verifies the exported journal. [testimony: the implementation lives outside this record, branch claude/history-journal-substrate, 2026-08-28]

Evidence bearing on EXPERIMENT-001 H2 (the vocabulary is small): in a 141-event curated store outside this record, the event-type vocabulary degenerated exactly as H2's long-tail warning predicted - 18 types in use against 9 declared, including four synonym clusters (merged/merge_completed; pull_request_opened/pr_opened; failure_diagnosed/diagnosis_completed; review_blocked/blocked_attempt/blocked_needs_operator), plus three undeclared evidence kinds. Free-form labels did degenerate into synonyms wherever nothing verified them. [testimony: measured 2026-08-28]

Convergence with the finding the X2 packet named - a meaning-free waist still leaks through content. Projecting an external history onto RFC-004's body shape found no slot for its evidence pointers (kind/repo/ref/url), so they were serialized into content as declared testimony rather than widening the body. Promoted as a challenge per EXPERIMENT-001 section 8, not smoothed: should the event body carry evidence as a first-class field, or is an external pointer only content? Recorded open. [testimony: 2026-08-28]

X2 packet mechanically assembled from commit 62f71ce and checked for blindness: READING-001, THEORY-001, 'discovery engine', 'debt engine', X2 and X-CORE appear nowhere in the assembled packet; the journal is truncated to its first 15 events and re-verifies standalone. The six core words still occur individually as ordinary RFC prose, which is not a leak - X2 tests independent assembly, not word absence. The reading itself remains unrun: no Claude session may run it, this one included. [testimony: 2026-08-28]

H5 observed in NATURAL occurrence, closing the observation EXPERIMENT-002 Run 2 explicitly left open. Two independent sessions appended to the same tip ea2261c4 without coordination: this session committed four events locally while eight events were pushed to origin. Shared prefix 21 events; both successors declare prev=ea2261c4; the linear chain forked in production, not in a harness. Resolution followed Run 2's verified procedure exactly - the local bodies were re-appended on the new tip 5532581f and their ids recomputed; nothing was force-pushed and nothing discarded. Independently confirms Run 2's architectural consequence: an event id is final only once pushed, bodies are the durable content. [testimony: 2026-08-28]
